visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with light brown hair, wearing semi-rimless glasses and a black t-shirt, stands outdoors against a green corrugated metal fence. He gestures animatedly with his hands while speaking directly to the camera. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a white Mercedes-Benz CLA front grille and hood, reflecting the bright sun. The man enters the frame, pointing at the car's headlights and bodywork. (3) A brief flash of an earlier state of the car is shown where the front bumper is missing, exposing the radiator and internal mechanical structures. (4) Back to the present, the man opens the hood to reveal a clean and fully assembled engine bay. He points to various components like the turbocharger and air intake. (5) The man opens the driver-side door and gestures toward the interior. The interior features black leather seats with red stitching and carbon fiber trim on the dashboard. (6) He sits in the driver's seat, buckled in with a red seatbelt. He starts the ignition and grips the steering wheel, smiling at the camera. (7) The car is seen driving on an asphalt road with green trees in the background. The man continues to talk while driving, occasionally adjusting his glasses or gesturing toward the dashboard screen which displays the Mercedes-Benz logo. (8) He turns the steering wheel while looking ahead, showing the car's movement and his control over the vehicle. The scene concludes with him making a final pitch to the camera from the driver's seat.
